messages:
deploy-bot: Rolling deploy started for service=api-gateway tag=v3.5.0 -> target=prod. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Canary 5%.
maya: Quick preflight check — can someone confirm p95/p99 across regions and 5xx rate before ramping? <https://dash.redwood/slo/prod|prod-slo>
liam: Pulling p95 now. US-W p95 82ms, EU p95 76ms. p99s look ok. 5xx rate baseline 0.03%.
becca: noticed a small bump in embed-service 5xx in EU ~00:12 UTC, ~0.12% for ~3m. Checking traces.
dom: logs show gRPC deadline exceeded from embed-worker -> embed-model on a subset of requests. Stack traces attached in logs: `grpc: deadline exceeded`.
slo-alert-bot: ALERT: embed-service 5xx rate > 0.1% (EU) for 3m. Current error budget burn 12%/hr.
maya: Thanks. Is that coincident with canary traffic or pre-deploy test traffic?
liam: Timestamp aligns with a small canary shard we just routed to EU. Canary traffic spiked briefly due to rollout pulse.
becca: Tracing shows KV cache miss rate increased from 7%->30% for those requests. Could be kvcache population issue with new runtime.
dom: Config diff: v3.5.0 enabled `prefetch_kv=true` + kernel change. Suspect prefetch causing backend churn. Rolling back that flag locally for a quick test.
maya: Given early canary 5% triggered alert and kvcache miss spike, I'd vote pause ramp. We can continue verifying while paused.
liam: Agreed — pausing automatic ramp. @deploy-bot pause-ramp v3.5.0
deploy-bot: Action taken: ramp paused for v3.5.0. Traffic remains at 5% canary. Notifying release lead.
becca: I'll open a short incident stub and mark impact low. Putting mitigation: revert `prefetch_kv` and re-run canary in EU only.
dom: Patch ready on a feature flag: `prefetch_kv=false`. I'll ship canary toggle to EU canary hosts in 10m and monitor.
slo-alert-bot: NOTE: Please monitor p99 and 5xx for next 15m. Alert threshold set at 0.1% 5xx.
maya: Update release notes: "paused ramp due to EU embed-service 5xx spike related to KV prefetch flag; mitigation under test." I'll also add a line in the changelog and ping CS.
liam: If mitigation clears within 20m we can resume ramp with a cautious schedule: 5%->10%->25% with 10m gaps.
becca: I'll keep the incident stub updated. tagging oncall rotation @dom @liam. Initial severity: sev3, no user-facing degradation reported yet.
maya: Thanks team. Dom, call if you need rollback instead of flag revert. We'll keep traffic at 5% until green.
dom: Will report back in ~12m with results from EU toggle.
bea: (emoji) :thumbsup:
